name: 前挡全覆盖防晒隔热遮阳挡款

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool grey-blue #EDF1F6 for banner and variant screens, deep navy #1F3557 and charcoal cabin #2B313A for macro and in-cabin screens
style.direction: premium automotive interior accessory ecommerce with a cool daylight safety mood
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and double-headed adjustment arrows in orange #F39A1E on dark panels, deep navy #1F3557 on light panels, rounded pill label chips
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral 5500-6000K; bright even high-key softbox key with soft fill and soft contact shadows on studio screens; low-key daylight entering through the covered glass inside the cabin; skimming light only for texture macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive interior accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool grey-blue #EDF1F6, deep navy #1F3557 and one orange accent #F39A1E; cool neutral studio lighting at 5500-6000K with bright even high-key softbox light on white screens and low-key daylight inside the cabin; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icon system with double-headed arrows and rounded pill chips; flat panel product always shown with dark stitched edge binding, stable scale and centering; one complete balanced layout per screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no real car brand badges, model names or year lists
style.presentationRules: the shade always reads as one flat rounded-corner panel with dark stitched edge binding, stable scale and centering, shown laid flat, fitted on glass, or rolled into its pouch; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte studio seamless board #EDF1F6 and #FFFFFF for flat screens, dark textured cabin dash and headliner for in-cabin screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep navy #1F3557 headlines on light panels and pure white #FFFFFF headlines on dark panels, one headline plus up to three short labels per screen
